title: Jazeera Airways operates inaugural flight to Addis Ababa
summary: Direct service strengthens connectivity between Kuwait and Ethiopia

Jazeera Airways 1st flight to Addis Ababa. Image Courtesy: Jazeera Airways

Direct service strengthens connectivity between Kuwait and Ethiopia

Press Release

Kuwait: Jazeera Airways, Kuwait’s leading low-cost carrier, today operated its inaugural flight from Kuwait to Addis Ababa, marking the launch of its newest destination in Africa and strengthening direct air connectivity between Kuwait and Ethiopia.

The inaugural flight was officially flagged off at Jazeera Terminal 5 (T5) with a ribbon-cutting ceremony led by H.E. Dr. Sied Muhumed Jibril, Ambassador of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to the State of Kuwait, and Naser Fahad Alobaid, Chief Executive – Government Affairs (CEGA) and CEO – T5, Jazeera Airways, celebrating this important new connection between the two countries.

H.E. Dr. Sied Muhumed Jibril, Ambassador of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to the State of Kuwait, said:

“Today’s inaugural flight represents an important new chapter in the longstanding relationship between Ethiopia and Kuwait. Direct air connectivity plays a vital role in bringing countries and communities closer together, and we welcome Jazeera Airways’ new service to Addis Ababa. We believe this route will contribute to stronger tourism, trade, investment and cultural exchange, while making travel more convenient for the large Ethiopian community in Kuwait. We look forward to seeing this connection grow and create new opportunities for both countries.”

The new service provides greater travel choice for the more than 70,000 Ethiopian nationals living in Kuwait, offering convenient direct connectivity for those travelling home to visit family and friends. It also creates new opportunities to support growing tourism, trade, investment and people-to-people ties between Kuwait and Ethiopia.

Paul Carroll, Chief Commercial Officer, Jazeera Airways, said:

“Addis Ababa is an important addition to our growing network as the first and one of the most strategic destinations in Eastern Africa. This new route serves the large Ethiopian community in Kuwait and supports growing business, trade and leisure travel between the two countries. As we continue to expand, we see Africa as a significant growth market, with Addis Ababa strengthening our presence on the continent while giving passengers convenient access through Kuwait to other destinations.”

Jazeera Airways will operate direct flights between Kuwait and Addis Ababa three times weekly with flights available for booking through the Jazeera Airways website: www.jazeeraairways.com and mobile app.
